Keep everything. Replace the placeholder PLAY with a tiny demo game, "Catch and Dodge", whose only job is to exercise every system so that genre templates can be remixed from it. Add these sections to game_spec.json:
{"meta":{"id":"template-zero","title":"Template Zero","scoreLabel":"Score"},"rules":{"lives":3,"duration":45,"resultInputDelay":0.6},"player":{"speed":900,"y":1080,"look":{"shape":"roundRect","color":"player","size":80}},"entities":[{"id":"hazard","kind":"hazard","fallSpeed":{"min":300,"max":520},"look":{"shape":"triangle","color":"hazard","size":64}},{"id":"coin","kind":"pickup","points":1,"fallSpeed":{"min":250,"max":400},"look":{"shape":"diamond","color":"pickup","size":48}}],"difficulty":{"spawnInterval":[{"at":0,"value":0.9},{"at":45,"value":0.35}],"pickupChance":[{"at":0,"value":0.45},{"at":45,"value":0.3}]},"input":{"bindings":{"left":{"keys":["ArrowLeft","KeyA"],"pointer":"zoneLeft"},"right":{"keys":["ArrowRight","KeyD"],"pointer":"zoneRight"},"moveTo":{"keys":[],"pointer":"drag"}}},"limits":{"entities":40},"text":{"controlsKeyboard":"Arrows / A D: move","controlsTouch":"Hold left or right side, or drag: move"}}

DEMO RULES
The player slides left/right along the bottom of the stage, clamped inside it. Hazards and coins fall from above, spawned by a timer whose interval follows difficulty.spawnInterval over elapsed run time (linear interpolation between points, hold the last value); difficulty.pickupChance decides coin vs hazard. Coin = +points, collect sound, "+1" popup. Hazard = lose a life, hit sound, flash, shake. Win when duration ends with lives left; lose at 0 lives. Score = coins collected. HUD: score top-left with lives below, remaining time top-center, pause top-right.
Drag on touch/mouse moves the player toward the pointer x; zoneLeft/zoneRight hold also work; keyboard arrows too. Same speed for all inputs.

STRUCTURE (this is what genre templates will reuse)
- world module: holds the run state (time, score, lives, active entity lists), reset() from the spec on PLAY.enter.
- systems as separate functions called in a fixed order each step: spawnSystem, movementSystem, collisionSystem (circle/AABB), scoringSystem, difficultySystem.
- entity types are data from the entities array: iterate the list, never if (id === 'coin') branches; the kind field selects behaviour.
- skins module: one draw function per entity kind (drawPlayer, drawHazard, drawPickup) reading only look. Gameplay never draws, skins never change state.
- curve(points, t) helper for every {at, value} array; range(r) helper for {min, max}.
- All spawned objects come from Pools sized by limits.

DEBUG
If debug.showFps: small overlay bottom-left with FPS averaged over 1 s and active entity count. debug.showHitboxes draws collision shapes as outlines. debug.invincible ignores damage. debug.timeScale scales game time.

FINAL CHECK
- No hard-coded gameplay number, color, string, sound or timing outside game_spec.json.
- Zero console errors, no allocations in the loop, no network requests.
- Run 5 times in a row: no leftover entities, timers or sounds between runs; best score kept after reload.
- Works at 9:32, 9:16, 1:1, 16:9 and 32:9, with keyboard only and touch only.
- SDK pause during play freezes everything and silences audio; resume shows the Paused screen.
Then list the modules with a one-line description each, and the game_spec.json sections.
